title: Golden Throne and Golden Toilet
text: The Golden Throne grants 100% bonus damage, Resistance V, Regeneration V and Saturation. You cannot dismount voluntarily; teleporting away ends the benefits. Mining it or sitting for five online minutes (ten in the Stilled Wastes or two and a half in the Fleeting Woods) leaves a Golden Toilet and a misty treasure orb.
The toilet permits free dismount and grants 20% bonus damage, Regeneration II and Saturation while seated.
